(3) The interior of a modern hotel room is revealed, featuring two twin beds with white linens, a grey patterned carpet, and a small round black table with two chairs near a window with white sheer curtains. (4) A dark cabinet holds a coffee machine, a kettle, and several bottles of water, with a person briefly adjusting a white cup in a drawer below. (5) A woman in a black vest and white shirt stands by a large window, looking out at the city view during the daytime. (6) The camera shows a clean bathroom with white tiles, a pedestal sink, a toilet, and a bathtub with a shower curtain. (7) A close-up displays three brown bottles of toiletries sitting on a glass shelf alongside a small packet of bath salts. (9) A close-up features a tube of Elixir sunscreen being squeezed, dispensing a small amount of product onto a person's fingers. (10) A woman applies the sunscreen to her face while looking into a mirror, using circular motions on her cheeks. (11) The final shots return to the exterior of the hotel, showing the street-level entrance with flags and the distinctive circular architecture from different angles.
